summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo, without running any code or committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with keyboard handling, click action_range_clicked, and an animated bar_position watcher); UnderlineBar gained a clickable_ranges input before width that attaches range_clicked('<name>') @click metadata per cell, with output unchanged when no ranges are given; Opacity now merges the blended color into the existing style so meta survives; the layout resolver Edge already had size, min_size, and fraction, so it was left unchanged. Also added docs/reference/tabs.md, a sandbox demo (sandbox/tabs_demo.py and .css), a clickable-range test in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, an opacity meta test in tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. Nothing was executed. One assumption is unverified: that rich's Style addition keeps the left operand's meta when the right operand has none. Open choices: spans are half-open, 0-size slots are fixed, letter search applies only to single-character keys, and find_tab_by_name returns the last index for duplicate names.
